tutorials.title: DIY Plastic Bottle Bangles
steps: Select a clean, rigid plastic bottle with smooth cylindrical sides.
Draw even guide rings (approx. 2-3 cm wide) and carefully cut along the lines.
Smooth the edges gently using sandpaper or a safe workshop edge bevel.
Decorate the bangle by wrapping upcycled yarn, fabric ribbons, or eco-friendly paint.
Seal ends with non-toxic craft glue and let set for durable daily wear.
tutorials.tip: Always wear safety goggles when cutting plastic and get adult supervision for blade tools.

tutorials.title: Upcycled Plastic Earrings
steps: Collect and thoroughly wash colored plastic bottle caps (#2 HDPE).
Cut caps into small flakes and press into a flat sheet under safe supervision.
Trace geometric shapes (teardrops, hexagons, circles) onto the cooled plastic sheet.
Cut out the shapes, smooth edges with a nail buffer or fine sandpaper.
Punch a small hole at the top and attach hypoallergenic earring hooks and jump rings.
tutorials.tip: Mixing contrasting cap colors gives a unique marbled gemstone effect.

tutorials.title: PlastiFish Ocean Mascot
steps: Clean a plastic bottle to serve as the fish torso.
Cut fins and a tail from flexible plastic scrap sheets.
Slot or securely fasten fins into small side slits on the bottle.
Layer sorted plastic caps overlapping like scales across the fish body.
Add contrasting caps for eyes and mouth to complete your ocean advocate mascot.
tutorials.tip: Save bottle caps of different shades of blue and green to create an authentic underwater gradient.

tutorials.title: Woven Plastic Storage Basket
steps: Cut discarded clean plastic bottles or sheets into uniform sturdy ribbons.
Interlock the base ribbons in a tight cross-weave pattern.
Bend side ribbons upward and weave continuous horizontal strips to build the basket walls.
Fold over top edges and reinforce with a rounded plastic rim strip.
Add handles and secure ends firmly with safe workshop fasteners.
tutorials.tip: Keep ribbon widths consistent for a symmetrical, durable basket.

faqs.a: This independent project is a functional prototype for the DelfiCycle concept. The marketplace is simulated locally; no real payments are processed.
We focus on plastic waste streams that are often discarded, then design practical products around their material properties.
The demo wallet rewards learning and participation. Completing tutorials and challenge actions adds coins to your browser's local wallet.
This version stores demo data in your browser's localStorage. It does not send form entries or purchases to a remote server.
